title: Psalms 58
paragraphs: ¹ Do you rulers truly speak what is right? Do you judge people fairly? ² No — in your heart you devise injustice, and your hands inflict violence on the earth. ³ The wicked go astray from birth; from the moment they are born, liars wander off the path. ⁴ Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops up its ears, ⁵ unwilling to hear the voice of a charmer, no matter how skillful the spell.

⁶ Break the teeth in their mouths, O God; shatter the fangs of the lions, LORD. ⁷ Let them vanish like water that seeps away; let them wither like trampled grass. ⁸ Let them be like a slug that melts as it moves, like a stillborn child that never sees the sun. ⁹ Before your pots can feel the heat of the thornwood — whether green or ablaze — he will sweep them away. ¹⁰ The righteous will be glad when they witness his vengeance; they will bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked.
¹¹ And people will say, "Surely there is a reward for the righteous; surely there is a God who judges the earth."
